records.detail: Banky Foiben'i Madagasikara publishes its full financial statements on its own site, and they open with a Rapport des auditeurs externes sur les etats financiers annuels for the year ended 31 December 2025. It is a JOINT audit by two firms signing together: Auditeurs Associes CGA, of Immeuble Les Jardins de Mahamasina, 101 Antananarivo, and Deloitte & Associes, of 6 place de la Pyramide, 92908 Paris-La Defense Cedex, France. The report runs eight pages and is signed in both cities at once, Antananarivo et Paris-La Defense, on 29 April 2026, by Rivoharisoa Randriambelomanana for Auditeurs Associes CGA and Julien Koscien for Deloitte & Associes. One of its key audit matters is the valuation of staff retirement and seniority benefits under the revised IAS 19, where the bank's social commitments stood at 267.5 billion ariary at 31 December 2025 against 305.7 billion a year earlier. This record is the Malagasy half of that joint signature.
records.source_title: Banky Foiben'i Madagasikara, Rapport des auditeurs externes sur les etats financiers annuels, exercice clos le 31 decembre 2025, pages 1 and 8
records.quote: Les Auditeurs Externes: Auditeurs Associes CGA

records.detail: The second half of the joint signature on Banky Foiben'i Madagasikara's 2025 accounts is Deloitte & Associes, Deloitte's French member firm, at 6 place de la Pyramide, 92908 Paris-La Defense Cedex. Its partner Julien Koscien signed the Rapport des auditeurs externes alongside Rivoharisoa Randriambelomanana of Auditeurs Associes CGA, in Antananarivo and Paris-La Defense together, on 29 April 2026, for the year ended 31 December 2025. So Madagascar's central bank accounts are signed off by a local firm and a Paris firm jointly, and the same Deloitte & Associes entity also audits the Banque de France, where a 2024 Council of the European Union decision approved it alongside Mazars. That makes Deloitte's French arm the auditor of two central banks on this map at once.
records.source_title: Banky Foiben'i Madagasikara, Rapport des auditeurs externes sur les etats financiers annuels, exercice clos le 31 decembre 2025, pages 1 and 8
